Container.Name: ununemploy
Container.Overview: Private job discovery across company career boards, Hacker News, X, and feeds. Includes a review inbox, matching explanations, scheduled collection, and tailored CV drafts when a job is saved. Applications and engagement are never automated.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open ununemploy in your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, candidate facts, source settings, saved jobs, and CV drafts/edits. Use local persistent storage.

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: Browser-facing home-network URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:3080. Use your actual host address. No application login.

Config.Name: Application Time Zone
Config.Description: Time zone used for the schedule display and scan history.

Config.Name: Scan Interval (Hours)
Config.Description: Four hours gives six scheduled scans per day. Each source also has its own request and page budgets.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: User ID for application-owned files. Match the owner of the appdata directory.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Group ID for application-owned files. Match the group of the appdata directory.

Config.Name: X Bearer Token (Optional)
Config.Description: Official X API bearer token. Can also be entered in Settings. X collection requires a post limit and activation in the app.

Config.Name: Codex Model
Config.Description: Requested model for the official Codex runtime using your ChatGPT subscription. No automatic model or billing fallback.

Config.Name: Codex Reasoning
Config.Description: Reasoning effort for tailored CV drafts.

Config.Name: Codex Runtime Directory
Config.Description: Persistent directory the app configures for the official Codex runtime. Sign in to your subscription on this server after installation.
